scale: own-plate vehicle centers; c and per-DIV robust SD from training-associated vehicles of each outer fit

baseline_definitions.nested_measured_only: three-point measured-only of arm B (common_scale R1 frozen margins with the observed-active lane (crc_obs)); key kept for figure scripts
baseline_definitions.nested_anchorboost: three-point AnchorBoost of arm B (common_scale R1 frozen margins with the observed-active lane (crc_obs)); key kept for figure scripts

limitations: Retrospective static neuronal assay replay with shared batches; no prospective wet-lab savings.
Reuses the arm three-point predictor, cutoff and rank reference at K4; no mixed-K retraining.
Conservative all-candidate joint calibration; one margin per fold for every fourth-dose rule.
Report means an early report before full measurement; the full-series reference is an assay label.
Random counts are exact expectations; equal-budget mixtures match expected costs, not a hard batch cap.
Bootstrap conditions on fitted models and calibration; no refit uncertainty or multiplicity correction.

lane.rule: stage 1: measured three points >= 3 reported active, else three-point call iff exact m3 > lambda; stage 2: measured four points >= 3 reported active, else four-point call iff exact m4 > lambda; else complete
